shared_elements: large antlered stag/deer in profile, solid dark silhouette
small schematic human figures running with flexed limbs
boar/bovid-like animal in dark silhouette, small scale, in profile
figures with dotted/hatched decoration on limbs or garments
scattered composition of many small figures around a dominant large animal
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: a single greatly oversized antlered stag rendered as a flat dark silhouette in profile, surrounded and dwarfed by numerous tiny, wiry, dynamically running human figures with bows, plus smaller silhouetted boar-like quadrupeds and occasional pale-coloured figures with dotted decoration on the limbs — a very specific and arbitrary combination of scale contrast, posture and infill convention. The only real difference is scope: A is a long panoramic frieze with additional rows of archers, bovids and canids extending well beyond the stag, whereas B presents only the stag-centred cluster, which appears to be essentially the same composition seen in detail.
